Nagpur sits at the centre of India, and it has built its economy on that position — the MIHAN SEZ with its cargo airport, aviation and logistics tenants, and Butibori MIDC, one of the largest industrial estates in Asia. Add the Hingna and Kalmeshwar MIDC belts and a steady flow of highway and EPC projects, and you have constant demand for solid, lockable site offices. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; as a Portable Container Office Supplier in Nagpur's wider region we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Nagpur buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Nagpur

Logistics, warehousing and cargo operators around MIHAN and the Wardha Road belt use them as gate, weighbridge and documentation cabins. Power, engineering and heavy-industry units at Butibori use them as project offices and supervisor cabins. Manufacturing units in the Hingna and Kalmeshwar MIDC belts use them as admin and QC cabins. EPC and infrastructure contractors use them as a site office container for MIDC projects that moves with the work. The common need is a rugged unit that arrives finished and holds up through Vidarbha's hot, dusty summers.

Nagpur industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial and logistics belts:

  • MIHAN SEZ / Wardha Road logistics belt — the multi-modal hub, cargo airport and SEZ tenants; gate, documentation and project cabins for logistics and aviation-linked work.
  • Butibori MIDC (441122) — a very large industrial estate (power, engineering, warehousing); project offices and supervisor cabins.
  • Hingna MIDC (440016) — the manufacturing, engineering and defence-support belt near the city; site and admin cabins.
  • Kalmeshwar MIDC (441501) — the engineering and process-industry estate on the north side; site offices and storage-cum-office units.

Sites outside these pockets — Kamptee, Umred or along the Nagpur ring road — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Nagpur
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftSite office, admin cabin, documentation room
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated against Vidarbha heat
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Nagpur orders are customised to the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and extra insulation for the hot summers and for admin use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; weighbridge-side window layouts for logistics gates; and ramps or external steps. Units can be a single relocatable office or built for sites that need a tougher shell. Tell us the team size, the site conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Nagpur

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Nagpur by road, around 950 km via NH44 through the Jhansi–Sagar corridor. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve the Mumbai container office page on the same western network, so the route into Maharashtra is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price and after-sales — useful on long-distance orders where coordination matters. We supply across Central, West and South India, including container offices we build for Pune and the container office page for Hyderabad.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Nagpur depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the transport to your site. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Nagpur?

Price depends on size, insulation, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

How long does delivery take to Nagpur?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, around 950 km away via NH44, with typical road transit of 3–5 days once the unit is built. We confirm the schedule at order stage based on your site location and access.

Do you supply site offices for MIHAN and Butibori projects?

Yes. MIHAN logistics and the Butibori industrial estate are major sources of demand around Nagpur. We supply gate cabins, project offices and supervisor cabins, fitted out for logistics and heavy-industry use, and can relocate units as the project moves.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Nagpur container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
